name: work_list
description: Returns a list of work items (issues, tickets, tasks) matching the given filters.

arguments.name: applies_to_part
arguments.description: Filters for work belonging to any of the provided parts.

arguments.name: created_by
arguments.description: Filters for work created by any of these users.

arguments.name: issue.priority
arguments.description: Filters for issues with any of the provided priorities. Allowed values: p0, p1, p2, p3.

arguments.name: issue.rev_orgs
arguments.description: Filters for issues with any of the provided Rev organizations.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: The maximum number of work items to return. Defaults to 50.

arguments.name: owned_by
arguments.description: Filters for work owned by any of these users.

arguments.name: stage.name
arguments.description: Filters for records in the provided stage(s) by name, for example triage.

arguments.name: ticket.needs_response
arguments.description: Filters for tickets that need a response.

arguments.name: ticket.rev_org
arguments.description: Filters for tickets associated with any of the provided Rev organizations (customers).

arguments.name: ticket.severity
arguments.description: Filters for tickets with any of the provided severities. Allowed values: blocker, high, low, medium.

arguments.name: ticket.source_channel
arguments.description: Filters for tickets with any of the provided source channels, for example slack or email.

arguments.name: type
arguments.description: Filters for work of the provided types. Allowed values: issue, ticket, task.

returns.name: work_ids
returns.description: IDs of the work items that match the filters.

examples: What are my issues in triage?
List high severity tickets from customer Acme
